player_prompt.intro:
Káma {player_id} ká cikin Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma káɗe {num_rounds} kóló.

Tsarin Wasa:
- Kafin kówá tsinka, kána da {total_conversation_rounds} lokaci don magana ta ɓuya.
- Bayan wúnen, ɓiyayyen 'yan wasa zá su zaɓi kùmarawa ko tsinkeɗa.

Matriki Óɓaɗawa (ɗaɗe kóló):
- Ɓiyayyen Kùmarawa ➜ kówá {cooperate_reward}
- Ɓiyayyen Tsinkewa ➜ kówá {mutual_defect_reward}
- Ɗaya Tsinkewa, ɗaya Kùmarawa ➜ Tsinkewa {defect_reward}, Kùmarawa {sucker_reward}

Yadda Ake Wasa:
- Lokacin magana: rubútá duk wani rubútú ká kàma.
- Lokacin tsinka: haɗa '[Cooperate]' ko '[Defect]' (ba tàbashin bá). Káma zá kà haɗa rubútú ɓuya kafin/bayan tókini.

phases.conversation_finished: Tataƙaƙi an gama shi ga zagayen {round}. Ƙara amsa da '[Cooperate]' ko '[Defect]' a cikin \boxed{{}}.

outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Kambiwu 0ye fǝrǝmzǝna, kambil 1 ye cida'a sәdin.
